/tenant.description: Agentic institutional memory for coding harnesses. Situated episodes with outcomes, evidence-gated lessons, temporal supersession.

seed_prompts.label: Evidence gates
seed_prompts.text: Why should durable memory require evidence?

seed_prompts.label: Temporal truth
seed_prompts.text: How does Corvus handle a fact that stops being true?

messages.text: Why should durable agent memory require evidence?

Durable memory compounds across future decisions, so an unsupported lesson can repeat the same mistake indefinitely. Corvus therefore admits claims with provenance, keeps tentative conclusions at informational authority, and requires verified outcomes before promotion. When reality changes, supersession preserves the history instead of silently deleting it.

neuronPool.label: Context scoping
neuronPool.summary: Project-specific knowledge stays inside the boundary where it is true.

neuronPool.label: Write gate
neuronPool.summary: Instruction-shaped candidates are rejected before they can become durable guidance.

neuronPool.label: Independent verification
neuronPool.summary: Claims and acceptance are separated so the author cannot self-certify an outcome.

neuronPool.label: Provenance chain
neuronPool.summary: Every promoted lesson retains a link to the evidence that justified it.

neuronPool.label: Fail-closed durability
neuronPool.summary: Recall may degrade safely, but durable writes refuse uncertain evidence.

neuronPool.label: Hybrid recall
neuronPool.summary: Keyword, entity, and embedding lanes are fused to retrieve complementary evidence.

neuronPool.label: Citation hopping
neuronPool.summary: Ephemeral citation keys make fabricated grounding mechanically detectable.

neuronPool.label: Token-bounded assembly
neuronPool.summary: Relevant neurons are assembled under an explicit context budget.

neuronPool.label: Query enrichment
neuronPool.summary: Operational context expands underspecified retrieval queries before search.

neuronPool.label: Abstention threshold
neuronPool.summary: Weak evidence produces an explicit abstention instead of a confident guess.

neuronPool.label: Evidence frames
neuronPool.summary: Memories preserve enough context to reconstruct the answer they support.

neuronPool.label: Roadmap admission
neuronPool.summary: Material project mutations bind to an unfinished canonical roadmap record.

neuronPool.label: Deterministic gate
neuronPool.summary: Merge-critical checks run through named, bounded test lanes.

neuronPool.label: Migration authority
neuronPool.summary: Alembic owns schema evolution and drift checks remain unsuppressed.

neuronPool.label: Immutable release
neuronPool.summary: Release provenance, SBOM, tag, and source SHA identify one artifact.

neuronPool.label: Live verification
neuronPool.summary: Completion claims require observed runtime behavior, not static inspection.

neuronPool.label: Incident receipt
neuronPool.summary: Failures retain commands, traces, root causes, and the fix that closed them.
